name: unattended-cross-host-scheduler
title: Productize user-authorized unattended cross-host scheduler
description: Add a policy-authorized unattended scheduler so Lattice can start Claude Code, Gemini, or Codex CLI workers only inside user-approved host, path, budget, timeout, environment, and authority boundaries. The user-visible outcome is a clear opt-in flow: define a safe policy, verify host capability, start an unattended run, watch worker status, inspect transcripts/receipts/diffs, and receive manual next actions without auto-merge, auto-DONE, or productionDone claims.
